news.title: ShipMonk Appoints Todd Bills as Chief Operating Officer

roles.title: Lead Product Manager, Merchant Platform & AI

bullets: Understand our merchants and their customers. Talk to merchants, join sales and Merchant Success calls, and build clear profiles of founders, e-commerce managers and operations…
Own the merchant roadmap. Set the direction and priorities for the merchant app, the MCP and agents, and our tools for growing sales and lowering costs.
Turn what you learn into products. Write clear problem statements and specs, build working prototypes yourself with AI coding tools, and ship with Engineering and Design.
Work with Marketing and Sales. Help with positioning, messaging, launch plans, and content. Give Sales clear explanations and good demos.
Drive adoption. Own usage after launch. Run beta programs, onboarding, and in-app prompts until merchants actually use the feature.
